scope: COV-018c emphatic/concessive particles, ㄴ커녕 contraction and locative 서; COV-017i separate -(으)나마 ending. Grouped corpus recovery is not contextual correctness or candidate precision.

linguistic_review.disposition: Segmentation review; the sentence concerns submission of a written pledge. The likely lexical document reading is an inference from context. This numerical gain is not promoted to a required linguistic candidate judgment. Original-word hypothesis remains.

scope_decisions: Particles and the homonymous ending are separate kinds, with separate dictionary lookups.
ㄴ커녕 normalizes to one 는커녕 particle; no fabricated character span or topic-plus-커녕 decomposition.
나마 after adverbial 게 has explicit source evidence. Further post-ending combinations remain open.

Locative 서 has no coda requirement; the old ABC서 vowel assumption is removed without removing its component group. The count-emphasis homonym retains narrower lexical scope and is not selected by this rule.
Bare 커녕 receives nominal attachment only; longer forms also have adverbial hypotheses.
Known suffix and nominalization composition preserve prior constraints; the new particles and ending are not new auxiliary connectors.
No new development gold matches are attributed to the separate -(으)나마 ending; its evidence is source-backed synthetic cases.
Independent Korean-language review and broader lexical/contextual licenses remain open.
